_comment: Every setting a reader is allowed to change, and exactly what it drives. Adding an entry here adds it to the settings panel, no component is edited. A 'choice' writes its chosen option's 'write' value into one CSS variable. A 'range' writes its own number. A 'switch' either writes the variables under 'off' while it is off, or is read directly by a component (the dictionary's synonyms). 'section' groups a setting under its module in the panel, in first-seen order. Defaults live here, so this file is the whole answer to 'what can be configured'.

settings.label: Animations
settings.help: Movement as things appear. Turn off if distracting.

settings.label: Study text size
settings.help: Arabic and English in Quran, tarkeeb, i'raab and sarf. Nothing else moves.

settings.label: Prefer Fusha
settings.help: Dictation leans to classical Arabic. Off: any Arabic.

settings.label: Checking level
settings.help: How closely your Qur'an reciting is checked, by words and vowels. Beginner forgives a little more. Standard checks closely and marks doubtful words orange to look at again. Tajweed is not checked yet.

settings.label: Carry on where you stopped
settings.help: Recording again in Memorise continues the same recitation. Off: it starts the page over.

settings.label: Show synonyms
settings.help: Other Arabic words with the same meaning, under each dictionary definition.

settings.label: Other dialects
settings.help: A quiet line under each phrase that shows it in the other dialects.

settings.label: English-letter spelling
settings.help: The sound written in English letters under the Arabic. Off: the Arabic alone.
